categories.main_business_segments: TCC Steel operates primarily in three strategic business segments: surface-treated steel sheets, real estate leasing, and others. The core business is the manufacturing and sales of surface-treated steel sheets including tin-plated steel, electrolytic chromium-coated steel, nickel-plated steel, copper-plated steel, super-tin, and laminate steel sheets. Subsidiaries engage in manufacturing (cutting), trading, real estate leasing, service, and equipment manufacturing and maintenance.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced surface treatment technologies for steel sheets including tin plating, electrolytic chromium treatment, nickel and copper plating, and laminate processes. It operates continuous heat treatment lines, slitter lines, and rolling mills with a total annual production capacity of 560,000 tons. Recent investments focus on automation, process rationalization, and a new dedicated nickel-plated steel line for secondary battery materials, incorporating smart factory initiatives.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include can manufacturers, crown manufacturers, and electronics companies primarily using tin-plated and chromium-treated steel for food and beverage containers, aerosol cans, and general industrial tubes. Nickel-plated steel is supplied to battery manufacturers for primary and secondary batteries, automotive tubes, and electronic components. The company serves domestic and international markets, including East Asia, the Americas, Europe, and emerging markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: TCC Steel operates mainly in South Korea with its production facilities located in Pohang. It exports approximately 63% of its products to various countries across East Asia, the Americas, Europe, and emerging markets. Subsidiaries like TCC America Corp handle trading activities in overseas markets, supporting global sales and distribution.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the steel supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and surface treatment of steel sheets. It procures raw materials such as BP and CR coils mainly from POSCO Holdings and tin from domestic suppliers, then processes and sells finished surface-treated steel products to downstream manufacturers and end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: TCC Steel emphasizes continuous R&D to improve product quality and develop new materials, including advanced surface-treated steel for semiconductor, aerospace, and electronics industries. Current R&D focuses include development of electro-tin-zinc alloy plated steel, heat-treated nickel-plated steel for battery cases, laminate steel sheets with polymer films, and stainless steel nickel plating for electronic applications. The company invests in smart factory technologies and aims to expand its presence in the growing secondary battery materials market.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales of surface-treated steel sheets, accounting for over 99% of sales. It also earns minor revenue from real estate leasing and other services. Sales are conducted via direct sales to manufacturers, distributors, and through export trading companies, with payment terms including cash, credit, and letters of credit.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Within the domestic tin-plated steel market, TCC Steel holds a stable market position alongside KG Steel, with SHD and imports covering the remainder. It is the sole domestic producer of nickel-plated, copper-plated, and laminate steel sheets, differentiating itself through product diversity and international quality recognition. The company faces competition from imported steel products and global suppliers but maintains competitiveness through quality and technological innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, TCC Steel reported consolidated revenues of approximately 624 billion KRW, with a 9% decrease from the previous year due to steel market downturns. Total assets increased by 10% to about 559.7 billion KRW, driven by investments in new nickel-plated steel production lines. The company experienced a decline in operating profit and net income, with net losses reported in 2023. It maintains a mid-sized corporate scale with ongoing capital investments aimed at future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: TCC Steel emphasizes high-quality surface-treated steel products with superior corrosion resistance, aesthetic finish, and functional properties tailored for food packaging, electronics, automotive, and battery applications. Its product differentiation lies in diversified plating technologies, advanced heat treatment processes, and development of next-generation materials like electro-tin-zinc alloy and nickel-plated stainless steel. The company leverages long-term customer relationships, technological leadership, and global quality standards to sustain competitive advantage.
